subject: IFEval staffing + distillation scope addition
body: Priya — staffing plus the scope addition we agreed at Thursday's sync. Core eval integration: Oyin 60% (Evalline runner API), Gustavo 30% (fleet sweep automation). The addition: the stretch goal is now in scope. There's nothing on the shelf internally for this, so we're scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe from scratch — teacher sampling, response filtering through the IFEval checker, and a finetuning loop that optimizes strict accuracy — with Yusuf at 60% and Rafael at 30% through June. First recipe milestone: an 8B student showing +5 points prompt-level strict accuracy by early July. Compute: titan-a100 best-effort suffices at 8B scale; no reservation ask. Dependency: the response-jsonl format from the fleet harness doesn't match evaluation_main's expected input yet — Oyin has a converter in review. — Alina
